rows.text: The Assembly's news item on Lord Fusitu'a's funeral states that 'Late Lord Fusitu'a was appointed the Hon. Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of Tonga in 1991'; its PARLIAMENTARY CAREER section says that he was appointed Speaker of the House by his late Majesty King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV and 'served for three terms from 1991-1998', and the item adds that he remained a Noble representative of the Niuas until he died at his residence on April 24, 2014.
rows.locator: Sentences beginning 'Late Lord Fusitu'a was appointed' and 'Dwelling near Mt Zion'; the PARLIAMENTARY CAREER section
rows.uncertainty: Retrospective year and span written 23 years later: claims only, not a start or an end. They conflict with the Assembly's lists (1990-1998 in 2011; 1995-1998 in 2006). The death is context, not a Speaker event.
